title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram

examples.explanation: Bars at indices 2 and 3 support a rectangle of height 5 and width 2, giving area 10.

inputFormat: heights is a nonempty array of nonnegative bar heights. Every bar has width 1.
outputFormat: Return the largest rectangle area under consecutive bars. Return 0 when all heights are zero.

visuals.title: The shorter bar limits the height
